self_resolved: The reader always lands on a report; the redirect-with-a-summary alternative is the failure the requirement names
Nothing about the run is stored, so the report exists once
The import action appears on both catalogue presentations, not only the table
The import page carries no permission check, matching what FS-008 settled for the other write paths
The report numbers entries from one while the import contract keeps its zero-based index
No duplicate detection; the import page warns before submission instead
The report is one page and is never paginated
The format is chosen by the reader and never detected from the file
Formats offered are read from the installation's configuration rather than listed in the front end
The feature reads the import contract and does not extend it; a genuine gap is raised as its own issue

Refined 2026-08-24: a skipped entry may carry a reason, amending the import contract (D14)
